Mega Evolution 2025–present

The Mega Evolution series began in 2025 and brought Mega Evolution Pokémon ex back to the card game.

English sets in release order

  1. Mega Evolution 2025
  2. Phantasmal Flames 2025
  3. Ascended Heroes 2026 special expansion
  4. Perfect Order 2026
  5. Chaos Rising 2026
  6. Pitch Black 2026

Japanese sets in our collection

  • M1L Mega Brave 2025
  • M2a MEGA Dream ex 2025

In stock: Mega Gengar ex ACE 10 (MEGA Dream ex M2a), Mega Venusaur ex PSA 10, Bulbasaur PSA 10, Mega Gengar ex ACE 10 (Ascended Heroes), Mega Dragonite ex PSA 9. All Mega Evolution graded cards →

Scarlet & Violet 2023–2025

Scarlet & Violet brought back Pokémon ex and introduced Illustration Rares and Special Illustration Rares, known as Art Rares and Special Art Rares in Japanese sets.

  2. Paldea Evolved 2023
  3. Obsidian Flames 2023
  4. 151 2023
  5. Paradox Rift 2023
  6. Paldean Fates 2024
  7. Temporal Forces 2024
  8. Twilight Masquerade 2024
  9. Shrouded Fable 2024
  10. Stellar Crown 2024
  11. Surging Sparks 2024
  12. Prismatic Evolutions 2025
  13. Journey Together 2025
  14. Destined Rivals 2025
  15. Black Bolt & White Flare 2025 special expansion

Japanese sets in our collection

  • SV8 Super Electric Breaker 2024
  • SV8a Terastal Festival ex 2024
  • SV9 Battle Partners 2025

In stock: Eevee ex PSA 10, Flareon ex PSA 10, Espeon ex PSA 10, Leafeon ex PSA 10, Jolteon ex PSA 10, Articuno PSA 10, Pikachu ex PSA 10. All Scarlet & Violet graded cards →

XY 2014–2016

XY is where Mega Evolution first arrived in the card game, alongside Pokémon-EX and BREAK cards. It closed with Evolutions, a reimagining of the original Base Set.

English sets in release order

  1. XY 2014
  2. Flashfire 2014
  3. Furious Fists 2014
  4. Phantom Forces 2014
  5. Primal Clash 2015
  6. Double Crisis 2015
  7. Roaring Skies 2015
  8. Ancient Origins 2015
  9. BREAKthrough 2015
  10. BREAKpoint 2016
  11. Generations 2016
  12. Fates Collide 2016
  13. Steam Siege 2016
  14. Evolutions 2016

Base Set and the Wizards of the Coast era 1999–2003

The original era published by Wizards of the Coast, from Base Set through the Neo and e-Card sets. 1st Edition and Shadowless Base Set cards are some of the most valuable in the hobby.

English sets in release order

  1. Base Set 1999
  2. Jungle 1999
  3. Fossil 1999
  4. Base Set 2 2000
  5. Team Rocket 2000
  6. Gym Heroes 2000
  7. Gym Challenge 2000
  8. Neo Genesis 2000
  9. Neo Discovery 2001
  10. Neo Revelation 2001
  11. Neo Destiny 2002
  12. Legendary Collection 2002
  13. Expedition 2002
  14. Aquapolis 2003
  15. Skyridge 2003
